name: BuyVM
tagline: Budget KVM VPS with unmetered bandwidth and DDoS protection
description: BuyVM is a budget KVM VPS provider run by FranTech Solutions, known for cheap storage-heavy plans, unmetered bandwidth and free DDoS protection add-ons.
about: BuyVM is a Canadian-owned VPS host operated by FranTech Solutions, built for developers who want raw dedicated resources rather than a shared-hosting-style dashboard. Its entry KVM 128 plan runs $25/year (1 core, 128MB RAM, 15GB SATA storage, 500GB bandwidth), while the monthly-billed KVM 256 ($5/mo, 2 cores, 256MB RAM, 30GB storage, 1TB bandwidth), KVM 512 ($10/mo, 2 cores, 512MB RAM, 50GB storage, 2TB bandwidth) and KVM 1024 ($20/mo, 4 cores, 1024MB RAM, 100GB storage, 5TB bandwidth) tiers scale up from there. Higher-volume plans go up to 8 cores / 4GB RAM / 200GB storage / 15TB bandwidth at $80/month.

Storage-focused customers get a separate line of Storage VPS plans (1 core/1GB RAM/250GB storage at $7/mo up to 8 cores/16GB RAM/4000GB storage at $120/mo) with unlimited bandwidth, aimed at Plex/media, backup and Seedbox-style workloads. Servers run on dual-hexa-core Intel Xeon hardware with RAID-10 (RAID-60 on storage nodes) drive arrays and no overselling, which means popular configurations regularly sell out.

BuyVM does not bundle cPanel or any mainstream control panel — management runs through Stallion, its own in-house-built server panel, plus the my.frantech.ca billing portal. This keeps prices low but means less hand-holding than a typical shared host; customers are expected to be comfortable administering their own Linux/Windows server. DDoS-protected IPs are available as a $3/month per-IP add-on, and data centers are located in Las Vegas (Nevada), Piscataway (New Jersey) and Luxembourg.
policies: BuyVM does not advertise a blanket money-back guarantee the way many shared hosts do; refund eligibility is handled case-by-case through a support ticket, and unused prepaid time on longer terms is not automatically refunded. Check the current terms of service on frantech.ca before purchasing if a refund window matters to you.
Because BuyVM operates on a strict no-overselling model, specific plan/location combinations frequently show as out of stock — availability, not price, is often the limiting factor when signing up.
